theorem ghost_signRank_bound_fixedCard (K : Complex (U ⊕ C)) (hK : K.Proper)
    (hv : ∀ i, K.face {i}) (S : R → Finset U) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hcard : ∀ r, (S r).card = k) (hSface : ∀ r, K.face ((S r).disjSum ∅))
    (H : Matrix R C ℝ) (hH : IsSignMatrix H)
    (hsign : ∀ r c, H r c = 1 ↔ K.face ((S r).disjSum {c}))
    (hP : Polytopal (ghostBier K)) :
    signRank H ≤ Fintype.card U ^ 2 - Fintype.card U + 1

theorem ghost_signRank_bound_arbitrary (K : Complex (U ⊕ C)) (hK : K.Proper)
    (hv : ∀ i, K.face {i}) (S : R → Finset U)
    (hSface : ∀ r, K.face ((S r).disjSum ∅))
    (H : Matrix R C ℝ) (hH : IsSignMatrix H)
    (hsign : ∀ r c, H r c = 1 ↔ K.face ((S r).disjSum {c}))
    (hP : Polytopal (ghostBier K)) :
    signRank H ≤ Fintype.card U ^ 2 - Fintype.card U + 2

theorem exists_core_schur_realization (K : Complex (U ⊕ C)) (hK : K.Proper)
    (hv : ∀ i, K.face {i}) (S : R → Finset U)
    (hSface : ∀ r, K.face ((S r).disjSum ∅))
    (H : Matrix R C ℝ) (hH : IsSignMatrix H)
    (hsign : ∀ r c, H r c = 1 ↔ K.face ((S r).disjSum {c}))
    (hP : Polytopal (ghostBier K)) :
    ∃ (G : Matrix U U ℝ) (d : C → ℝ) (u v : C → U → ℝ),
      (∀ r, IsUnit (principalMatrix G (S r)).det) ∧
        SignRealizes H (schurFeatureMatrix G S d u v)

theorem paddedPrincipalInverse_span_finrank (G : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    {R : Type*} (S : R → Finset ι) (hS : ∀ r, IsUnit (principalMatrix G (S r)).det) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun r => paddedPrincipalInverse G (S r)))) ≤
      Fintype.card ι ^ 2 - Fintype.card ι + 1

theorem signRank_spectral (H : Matrix R C ℝ) (hH : Bier.IsSignMatrix H) :
    Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card R : ℝ) * Fintype.card C) ≤
      (Bier.signRank H : ℝ) * spectralNorm H

theorem hadamard_columnRestriction_signRank (A : Matrix R R ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsHadamard) (e : C ↪ R) :
    Fintype.card C ≤ Bier.signRank (A.submatrix id e) ^ 2

theorem bier_isSphere (K : Complex V) (hK : K.Proper) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    (K.bier hK).IsSphere (Fintype.card V - 2)
theorem allColumnSigns_signRank : signRank (allColumnSigns R) = Fintype.card R + 1

theorem general_allSign_construction_unrestricted (m k : ℕ)
    (hchoose : m ^ 2 - m + 2 ≤ m.choose k) :
    ∃ h : (m ^ 2 - m + 1) + 1 ≤ m.choose k,
      (patternInput m k (m ^ 2 - m + 1) h).dimension = k ∧
      (patternSphere m k (m ^ 2 - m + 1) h).IsSphere
        (m + 2 ^ (m ^ 2 - m + 1) - 1) ∧
      (patternSphere m k (m ^ 2 - m + 1) h).vertices.card =
        2 * (m + 2 ^ (m ^ 2 - m + 1)) + 1 ∧
      ¬ Polytopal (patternSphere m k (m ^ 2 - m + 1) h)
